name: Holy Hand Device ~Sakusei Shikake no Kikai Ningyou~
original_name: Holy Hand Device 搾精仕掛けの機械人形
source:
In a distant future where humans have long disappeared, the world is now inhabited by the Scra - artificial beings created from ancient machinery. Dreaming of becoming like the humans they once served, the Scra developed the Yukiroid.

But something went wrong.

The Yukiroid inherited humanity's darkest aspects instead of their virtues. Now these mechanical beings roam the world, driven by destructive impulses and an unnatural thirst for life essence.

You are the Liberator - the last hope to restore balance.

Accompanied by Paper, a unique Yukiroid designed to hunt her own kind, you must fight through hordes of corrupted androids. Each battle brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind humanity's disappearance and the Scra's doomed attempt to recreate them.

The Yukiroid see you as their key to becoming human. Some want to destroy you. Others want to consume you. All stand between you and the answers buried in this mechanical wasteland.

[Rewritten from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01250461.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
在人类早已消失的遥远未来，世界现在居住着斯克拉——由古代机器创造的人造生物。斯克拉人梦想成为像他们曾经服务的人类一样，因此开发了尤基里德人。

但出了点问题。

Yukiroid继承了人类最黑暗的一面，而不是他们的美德。现在，这些机械生物在破坏性冲动和对生命本质的不自然的渴望的驱使下在世界上漫游。

你是解放者——恢复平衡的最后希望。

在Paper（一种独特的Yukiroid，旨在猎杀同类）的陪伴下，你必须与成群的腐败机器人作战。每场战斗都让你更接近揭开人类消失背后的真相，以及斯卡拉注定要重建人类的尝试。

Yukiroid将你视为他们成为人类的关键。有些人想毁掉你。别人想吃掉你。所有这些都挡在你和埋藏在这片机械荒原中的答案之间。

[重写自 [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01250461.html/]dlsite[/url]]
